parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: Granularity
parameters.description:
The data granularity of the response. You can only query data for up to 31 days at daily granularity. Valid values:

- **DAY**: Query data at daily granularity.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
